title: The MocR/GabR Ectoine and Hydroxyectoine Catabolism Regulator EnuR: Inducer and DNA Binding.
authors: Hermann, Lucas; Dempwolff, Felix; Steinchen, Wieland; Freibert, Sven-Andreas; Smits, Sander H J; Seubert, Andreas; Bremer, Erhard
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MocR/GabR家族转录因子EnuR与诱导物及DNA的结合，涉及结构建模和对接，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: The compatible solutes ectoine and 5-hydroxyectoine are widely synthesized by bacteria as osmostress protectants. These nitrogen-rich tetrahydropyrimidines can also be exploited as nutrients by microorganisms. Many ectoine/5-hydroxyectoine catabolic gene clusters are associated with a regulatory gene (enuR: ectoine nutrient utilization regulator) encoding a repressor protein belonging to the MocR/GabR sub-family of GntR-type transcription factors. Focusing on EnuR from the marine bacterium Ruegeria pomeroyi, we show that the dimerization of EnuR is mediated by its aminotransferase domain. This domain can fold independently from its amino-terminal DNA reading head and can incorporate pyridoxal-5'-phosphate (PLP) as cofactor. The covalent attachment of PLP to residue Lys302 of EnuR was proven by mass-spectrometry. PLP interacts with system-specific, ectoine and 5-hydroxyectoine-derived inducers: alpha-acetyldiaminobutyric acid (alpha-ADABA), and hydroxy-alpha-acetyldiaminobutyric acid (hydroxy-alpha-ADABA), respectively. These inducers are generated in cells actively growing with ectoines as sole carbon and nitrogen sources, by the EutD hydrolase and targeted metabolic analysis allowed their detection. EnuR binds these effector molecules with affinities in the low micro-molar range. Studies addressing the evolutionary conservation of EnuR, modelling of the EnuR structure, and docking experiments with the inducers provide an initial view into the cofactor and effector binding cavity. In this cavity, the two high-affinity inducers for EnuR, alpha-ADABA and hydroxy-alpha-ADABA, are positioned such that their respective primary nitrogen group can chemically interact with PLP. Purified EnuR bound with micro-molar affinity to a 48 base pair DNA fragment containing the sigma-70 type substrate-inducible promoter for the ectoine/5-hydroxyectoine importer and catabolic gene cluster. Consistent with the function of EnuR as a repressor, the core elements of the promoter overlap with two predicted EnuR operators. Our data lend themselves to a straightforward regulatory model for the initial encounter of EnuR-possessing ectoine/5-hydroxyectoine consumers with environmental ectoines and for the situation when the external supply of these compounds has been exhausted by catabolism.
abstract_zh: 相容性溶质ectoine和5-hydroxyectoine被细菌广泛合成，作为渗透压保护剂。这些富含氮的四氢嘧啶类化合物也可被微生物用作营养物质。许多ectoine/5-hydroxyectoine分解代谢基因簇与一个调控基因（enuR：ectoine营养利用调控因子）相关联，该基因编码一种属于GntR型转录因子MocR/GabR亚家族的阻遏蛋白。以海洋细菌Ruegeria pomeroyi中的EnuR为研究对象，我们表明EnuR的二聚化由其氨基转移酶结构域介导。该结构域可独立于其氨基末端DNA读取头进行折叠，并能结合吡哆醛-5'-磷酸（PLP）作为辅因子。通过质谱分析证实了PLP与EnuR的Lys302残基共价连接。PLP与系统特异性的、源自ectoine和5-hydroxyectoine的诱导物相互作用：分别为α-乙酰二氨基丁酸（alpha-ADABA）和羟基-α-乙酰二氨基丁酸（hydroxy-alpha-ADABA）。这些诱导物在细胞以ectoines作为唯一碳源和氮源活跃生长时，由EutD水解酶产生，并通过靶向代谢分析得以检测。EnuR以低微摩尔范围的亲和力结合这些效应分子。针对EnuR进化保守性的研究、EnuR结构的建模以及与诱导物的对接实验，初步揭示了辅因子和效应物结合腔的特征。在该腔中，EnuR的两种高亲和力诱导物alpha-ADABA和hydroxy-alpha-ADABA的定位方式使得它们各自的伯氮基团能够与PLP发生化学相互作用。纯化的EnuR以微摩尔亲和力结合一个包含sigma-70型底物诱导启动子的48碱基对DNA片段，该启动子控制ectoine/5-hydroxyectoine输入体和分解代谢基因簇。与EnuR作为阻遏蛋白的功能一致，启动子的核心元件与两个预测的EnuR操纵子重叠。我们的数据为含有EnuR的ectoine/5-hydroxyectoine消费者初次接触环境中的ectoines，以及当这些化合物的外部供应被分解代谢耗尽时的情形，提供了一个直接的调控模型。
